verification: Checked the specified versions' HTML tables and original PDF tables. PDFs are identified by SHA256 and are not redistributed.
display: Published means only; source-reported averages are preserved rather than recomputed from rounded suite values. Available source standard errors are retained below.
interpretation: Published rows are literature results, not reruns by this project. ANCHOR is generated separately from data/episodes.jsonl. Information, training and evaluation conditions differ.

openvla.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model

model_size.count_kind: Source-reported rounded model size; not a local checkpoint count

openvla.input_setting: Third-person RGB image and language instruction; no wrist image.
openvla.training_setting: Separate policy per suite; successful demonstrations with near-zero actions removed. Diffusion Policy is trained from scratch; Octo and OpenVLA are fine-tuned.
openvla.evaluation_setting: 500 trials per suite per run, with reported means and standard errors over the three runs described in Appendix E.1.
openvla.primary_result_producer: The OpenVLA authors evaluated all three selected methods in this table.

smolvla.title: SmolVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable and Efficient Robotics

model_size.count_kind: Source-reported rounded size of the selected simulation model
model_size.location: Table 2; Sections 4.1 and 4.5 describe demonstration-based policy training

smolvla.input_setting: RGB images, robot state and language in the model architecture; Table 2 does not enumerate the LIBERO camera count.
smolvla.training_setting: VLM initialization; no robotics-data pretraining for this selected simulation row; multitask policy trained on a 1693-episode LIBERO dataset covering the 40 tasks.
smolvla.evaluation_setting: 10 trials per task; binary task completion. Section 4.3 describes a new action prediction after each executed simulation action.
smolvla.average_note: The source reports 87.3, although the mean of its displayed integer suite values is 87.25; the reported value is retained.

openvlaoft.title: Fine-Tuning Vision-Language-Action Models: Optimizing Speed and Success
openvlaoft.selected_variant: Full OpenVLA-OFT, PD&AC and Cont-L1, additional inputs, modified training dataset

model_size.count_kind: Reported 7B base model class; not a local count of the adapted checkpoint
model_size.location: Section III; Appendix A-A describes the architecture

openvlaoft.input_setting: Third-person RGB, wrist RGB, robot proprioceptive state and language.
openvlaoft.training_setting: Pretrained OpenVLA fine-tuned independently per suite; unsuccessful demonstrations and near-zero actions filtered out.
openvlaoft.evaluation_setting: 500 trials per suite (10 tasks x 50 episodes); checkpoint selected by the source's reported evaluation procedure.
openvlaoft.average_note: The source reports 97.1; the reported average is retained.
